purpose: THE C APPLICABLE SET, as a machine-readable table: one row per relationship type the C language can express (decided from the PINNED GRAMMAR's own enumeration, never from the ten-value matrix), with the emission site in src/ast/real-c-analyzer.ts and at least one fixture that can go RED for it — plus the ruled non-applicable canonical values.

grammar.pinNote: full sha256 in the instrument artifact; the short form is the value the analyzer head comment and c-completeness.json carry (sha256 f9a2d771…, tree-sitter-c@0.24.1)
grammar.enumeration: 366 node-type slots = 128 NAMED types + 202 anonymous tokens, enumerated through web-tree-sitter's Language API (nodeTypeCount / nodeTypeIsNamed / nodeTypeForId). ERROR and MISSING are universal parser outputs, not grammar productions, and are classified separately in c-completeness.json.

admissibilityRule: A canonical value is APPLICABLE to C iff (i) every construct production it needs is present in the pinned grammar's enumeration, (ii) src/ast/real-c-analyzer.ts has at least one EMISSION site for it, (iii) at least one committed fixture carries a positive `expectRelationships` row naming it, and (iv) that fixture goes RED when the emission is removed (measured through the real fixture runner, one mutated analyzer per value). A value failing any conjunct is a finding; the instrument exits 1 when any conjunct fails.

cap50Population.corpusTotalUnit: admitted .c files discovered by the gate in .corpus (39 repos); excluded from that population: 755 tracked-but-absent/unreadable + 1 over the 1 MB cap
cap50Population.exitMeaning: FAIL on clause 1 — the baseline has unresolved/ambiguous rows; that is the state being worked, not an instrument error

calls.rule: call_expression with an identifier / field_expression / function-pointer callee. A call-shaped DECLARATION is not a call (#912); a function-like macro invocation gets both calls and uses (#908) while a `#define` replacement list that recovery reads as a call gets neither (definition site).
calls.cap50ResidualClass: unresolved 2011: declaration lives in a project HEADER outside the .c run, or is a name declared nowhere in the run (third-party/POSIX macros) — C-D2 per-file model; the 495 extOK are ISO C standard-library names claimed with `isExternal` and verified by the project.

uses.rule: a READ of an in-file declared name: field reads (field_access) and bare identifier reads; assignment-LHS / update targets are WRITES and are published as uses per #960 (the ontology has no `writes` kind, so silence would be an unrepresented fact), never dropped.
uses.cap50ResidualClass: field-read targets on structs whose declared type is not in the file (struct members are resolved through the owner channel); macro constants declared in unsampled headers.

contains.rule: container → member: struct/union → field (kind property), enum → enumerator (kind enum_member). The edge MOVES WITH its symbol and its line is the member's NAME line (#921), not the declaration start.
contains.cap50ResidualClass: none — fully resolved on this stride (collRes 24 are resolved picks among duplicate member names; the clang-14 instrument is the independent correctness reference: 421/421 members agreed).

imports.rule: preproc_include → the include path, published as the first-class `imports` kind (import_based evidence tier). The target is a module path and the source is the file-scope identity, so NEITHER endpoint is a symbol by construction of the type — 0% resolution is the type's shape, not a failure rate.
imports.cap50ResidualClass: path-target-not-a-symbol 152 (declared by construction; the .c-only population cannot admit a header as a target, and marking system includes external would trade unresolved for an unverifiable ext? claim — refused).

references.rule: a TYPE mention in a type position (declarator type fields, sizeof/cast TYPE operands, parameter/field types) targeted at the file's declared type. A value identifier in a value position is `uses`, not `references`; the two share one emission site and are chosen by position.
references.cap50ResidualClass: ambiguous 5 (a type name declared as two kinds in the file's project); 0 unresolved.

exports.rule: THREE emission forms, each with its refusals: (A) a linkage marker the file defines (every definition opens `extern`, none names `dllimport`; a marker on a LOCAL declaration is refused — #989), (B) a GNU/`__attribute__` spelling of the same boundary, (C) compound-statement declarations the recovery pass carries. FALSE edges rank above missing ones and are pinned by forbid rows.

redProof.note: including c/exports-assertion-macro-992 (#992: its forbid rows fire when the bare-identifier guard is removed — measured 45/3 -> 44/4 with the guard reverted)

exports.cap50ResidualClass: the marker token is not a symbol (`__declspec(dllexport)`), so an exports target cannot resolve by name by construction; the .c stride is also thin for this type (the export-dense files are headers). D2 must count it whole-population.

overrides.rule: ADAPTED SEMANTICS, DECLARED: C has no inheritance. The relationship is a REDEFINITION (C 6.9p5 / C 6.10.3p2): two definitions in mutually exclusive preprocessor arms (`shape: conditional-redefinition`), or `#undef X` then `#define X` (`shape: undef-redefine`). An unconditional second definition is a constraint violation and is REFUSED; so is a pair with no shared conditional (26 pairs over 7 sqlite files, refused and recorded). The edge runs from the LATER definition to the earlier one; both endpoints are the same name and `metadata.overridesLine` carries the prior line.
overrides.cap50ResidualClass: none on this stride (self-name edges resolve to the declaration).

instantiates.rule: an ALLOCATION whose produced type the source STATES: `(T *)malloc(...)` reads the cast, else `sizeof(T)` in the argument list; the target must be a type the file DECLARES, so `void *` allocates no named type (#962/#989). The allocator register is the measured set of wrappers found in the corpus, not a name list invented from intuition.
instantiates.cap50ResidualClass: none on this stride (2/2 resolved). Whole-population emission measured by the lane's own scan: 182 edges over 5,002 .c files, 182/182 with a same-file type declaration.

extends.reason: C has no class and no superclass slot — none of the productions above exists in the pinned grammar, so no declaration can write an IS-A relation. (C-D1.)
extends.corpusHalf: measured 0 edges on the clean .c-only 400-file stride while six other types fire on the same files; cross-grammar control in c-completeness.json finds base_class_clause only in the cpp grammar, etc.

implements.reason: no interface/conformance production exists in the pinned C grammar; nothing a declaration could satisfy. (C-D1.)
implements.corpusHalf: measured 0 edges on the same clean stride; cross-grammar control finds interface_declaration in c_sharp/groovy/java only.

decorates.reason: C has no decorator/annotation production. It DOES have attribute_specifier/attribute_declaration (GNU and C23 attributes), and they are adjudicated rather than ignored: an attribute names no declaration of its own (a keyword/macro-written specifier, not an applied callable) and the analyzer records linkage/storage-class attributes as SYMBOL METADATA — the same ruling the java lane applied to annotations. No C fixture expects an attribute-shaped decorates edge.
decorates.corpusHalf: extends/implements zero is grammar-absence; decorates is the same class one vocabulary generation later.

renders.reason: no JSX/element-construction production exists in the pinned C grammar; C never creates a component-element pair.

mixes_in.reason: no mixin/with production exists in the pinned C grammar.

part_of.reason: C's file-inclusion construct is `#include`, which IS a module/binding edge and is published as `imports`; there is no part-file directive that shares one library scope without importing — the distinction `part_of` exists to draw does not exist in C.
